activities.description: The Miz carries Cody Rhodes on his shoulders.
The Miz attempts a finishing move (Go To Sleep)
Cody Rhodes counters The Miz's move.
Cody Rhodes slams The Miz to the mat.
Cody Rhodes pins The Miz for the victory.
